description: In an Uno app project, SessionStart (also after a compaction) tells the agent that a running app is edited through Hot Reload status, not rebuilt, and to look for a running app before the first build; elsewhere it prints nothing. After a .xaml or .cs edit, PostToolUse asks the DevServer (uno-devserver app hot-reload-status) whether the running Uno app applied it through Hot Reload and tells the agent the result, so it asserts with uno_app_find_elements, fixes the reported compile errors, or restarts only for a rude edit or a DevServer internal error. Without the CLI or a solution file above the edited file, it reminds the agent that Hot Reload applies the edit; with no app connected yet, it says nothing.
